result: At pinned modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, crates/rmcp/tests/test_task.rs provides end-to-end in-process evidence that a ClientInfo built with ClientCapabilities::builder().enable_tasks().build() is used through service initialization before task operations and that the declared tasks capability reaches the server request context: TaskServer::call_tool checks context.client_capabilities().supports_tasks() and returns a task only when true, while task_lifecycle_create_poll_complete uses tasks_client_info().serve(...).await.unwrap() and then follows the task-return path to completed result 42. The companion no_task_without_extension_capability test uses a plain client and receives a synchronous non-task result. Combined with worker203 serialization evidence, this establishes SDK-level capability propagation through the initialization/service path, but not ChatGPT product control, remote deployed-server acceptance, scheduled-Chat transport availability, durable task persistence across process loss, or richer-mode parity.
